description: Phase 13 conversational evaluation fixtures — referential follow-up questions against the Acme Supply Co. policy pack. Each entry carries a short history whose referent the follow-up question alone cannot resolve; the harness derives the retrieval query from history + question (specs/014-chat-multi-turn-context, docs/chat.md §4.1) and reports recall@6. Facts reuse qa.json so answer_contains verifies against the same pages; pages are 1-indexed.

history.content: What is the refund window for returned items?
Returns are refunded within 30 days of purchase.

queries.question: and what condition must the item be in to get the refund?

history.content: Is there a fee to return unopened items?
No fee for unopened items.
What items are not refundable?
Perishable goods are not refundable.

queries.question: and can gift cards be returned or exchanged?

history.content: How quickly is a refund issued after you inspect the return?
Within 5 business days of inspection.

queries.question: and where do I submit my request?

history.content: What happens if my order arrived damaged?
Damaged orders get a full refund or replacement.

queries.question: and what about a defect that shows up later?

history.content: How long after confirmation does an order ship?
Orders ship within 2 business days.

queries.question: and how fast is standard shipping?

history.content: At what order total does shipping become free?
Free shipping on orders over $50.

queries.question: and is free shipping available for international orders?

history.content: Can I change the delivery address after ordering?
You can change the address after ordering.

queries.question: within how many hours must I do it?

history.content: How many hours are in the standard workweek?
The standard workweek is 40 hours.

queries.question: and how much paid vacation do new hires accrue in the first year?

history.content: How much notice should a resigning employee give?
Two weeks of notice.

queries.question: and can employment be ended without cause?

history.content: How long is paid parental leave for new parents?
12 weeks of paid parental leave under benefits.

queries.question: and what about unpaid family leave?

history.content: How long must work passwords be and what extra step is required?
Passwords must be 12 characters with MFA.

queries.question: and what should I do when I get a suspicious phishing email at work?
